# Security at Apex Linux

## Report a vulnerability

If you believe you’ve found a security vulnerability in Apex Linux, please report it privately through GitHub Security Advisories or contact the maintainers.

Please don’t report potential vulnerabilities publicly in GitHub Issues before they’ve been resolved.

## What is a vulnerability?

We consider a bug a security vulnerability when it can be exploited to cross a meaningful security boundary: an untrusted or lower-privileged party gains access, permissions, or control they didn’t already have.

## Regular bugs and support

For anything that isn’t a security vulnerability, please use the [Apex Linux issue tracker](https://github.com/sanjjaystars/Apex-linux/issues).
